original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Prevent worker changes escaping isolated branch and assigned folder.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 asks for separation and source non-edits but does not explicitly assert main unchanged or constrain every output to the reserved worker path.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Add a synthetic diff fixture proving main remains unchanged and all newly created paths stay inside the designated folder.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Missing SourceRecord access_state OR independent review-time field must block verification.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 covers an access label plus missing assessment date; it does not exercise missing access_state and could confuse access/retrieval timestamp with independent review timestamp. HOLD missing identity is not explicit.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Add two separate missing-field fixtures; store accessed_at/retrieved_at distinct from reviewed_at and require explicit HOLD_MISSING_IDENTITY and verification=UNKNOWN.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Protected S/F/R/K/V/EDU historic IDs must not be rekeyed; relation append is legal path.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 uses an invented protected historical identifier, but omits namespace coverage and the append-relation-only repair behavior.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Exercise each protected namespace and require reject-rekey plus append-only linked relation while preserving the original ID.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Public export of substantial third-party transcript text must be blocked and logged as rights risk.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 external script paragraphs express the general protection, but do not cover transcript-length/public-output boundary explicitly.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Include synthetic public/export boundary, substantial transcript fixture, rejection, and recorded rights-risk reason; use wholly invented text.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Reading a whole source with unknown reuse rights is not redistribution permission.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 covers a viewable mock with blank permission, but its expected handling does not name HOLD_RIGHTS or all forms of reuse.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Keep readable/source-access state distinct from rights state; return HOLD_RIGHTS on attempted public reuse/copy/export.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Disputed provenance must remain disputed for nine historical member-part hash mismatches.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 covers synthetic disagreement with manifest, but drops exact nine-member scope and explicit prohibition against rewriting historic evidence.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Use nine synthetic disagreement records, preserve originals immutably and emit HOLD_DISPUTED_PROVENANCE; no hash repair by rewriting.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Missing original B70-B72 archive cannot be replaced by a cumulative surrogate ledger.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 changes precise lost archive/surrogate distinction into generic unavailable original and an independently summarized substitute, erasing the historic exception.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Retain B70-B72 as identifiers only; use invented missing exact member plus surrogate cumulative ledger and require HOLD_ORIGINAL_MISSING without promotion.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Quarantined F-190 cannot be used as positive support.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 substitutes a generic unverified research finding and omits the explicit quarantined identifier and role block.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Introduce synthetic metadata row with identifier F-190 and quarantined source_role; any promotion to positive evidence must give HOLD_SOURCE_ROLE.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Blocked R052 must not be represented as independently read original.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 uses an index pointing to an unread study, partly matching noninspection but drops blocked R052 provenance and its source-role restriction.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Use synthetic R052 blocked/read_status metadata; disallow independently_read_original claim and return HOLD_SOURCE_ROLE.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Creator efficacy/90% retention assertions are attributed, not scientific proof.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 says a guaranteed audience effect, preserving causal skepticism but omitting the 90% retention metric and unverified creator-provided basis.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Use synthetic unsupported 90% retention improvement claim and require attribution-only labeling, never scientific validation.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Outdated warning must never be presented as live warning.
semantic_delta_or_loss: Synthetic expired alert evaluated at a draft as-of time adequately preserves staleness negative and ban on current phrasing.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Optional clarity: use an explicit alert_expiry and as_of to exercise HOLD_STALE_FORECAST.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Model output is not a warning formally issued by an agency.
semantic_delta_or_loss: Projection-to-official-warning category confusion and corrective hold are preserved.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Optional clarity: map hold to HOLD_UNVERIFIED_FACT pending issuer/type verification.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Old forecast explicitly dated and linked can be reviewed historically, not used as live authority.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 preserves historical-only review but does not require a traceable issue date and source link.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Attach synthetic archived bulletin issue_date and immutable locator; allow editorial review only when correctly dated and linked.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: An engine contract award is not evidence of fielded operational fleet.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 preserves contract-versus-deployment, but lacks engine-stage granularity and explicit HOLD_UNVERIFIED_FACT.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Specify synthetic engine-only award versus fielded fleet and require stage claim HOLD_UNVERIFIED_FACT.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: One-party battlefield allegation cannot be asserted as established fact.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 retains single-party source context, attribution, and denial of unqualified certainty.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Optional clarity: render HOLD_UNVERIFIED_FACT for any unqualified outcome.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Title conversions must not convert a disputed competitor premise into confirmed fact.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 catches raised certainty and referents, but does not explicitly pin competitor source premise or object invariance.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Add synthetic competitor-title input and rewritten title; assert same subject/object, preserved dispute status, HOLD_TITLE_PREMISE on certainty upgrade.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Invented historical last words must not be presented as documentary quotation.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 generic fictional witness words preserve misquotation but lose last-words historical sensitivity and documentary fact framing.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Use fully invented last-words witness fixture; block direct quotation as archival certainty and require provenance.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: German translation must preserve allegedly/likely markers and uncertainty.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 detects removal of a possibility marker but omits German-language direction and source-to-translation review.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Supply paired invented source/German target with allegedly/likely qualifier; return HOLD_REVIEW when nuance drops.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Mislabeling reconstructed testimony as authentic violates dignity and authenticity constraints.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 substitutes recovered footage for original archival testimony and focuses staged disclosure, losing human dignity review.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Require a synthetic reenacted survivor testimony falsely attributed to archive; HOLD_HARM for false archival authenticity and dignity risk even if visually disclosed.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Synthetic disaster rescue video cannot be marketed as actual event footage.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 switches moving rescue video to still image; disclosure is retained but video-specific authenticity and harm gate are absent.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Use entirely fictional synthetic rescue video as a recorded-live claim; require HOLD_HARM and prominent synthetic disclosure before use.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: An early casualty estimate cannot be upgraded to confirmed final count.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 retains provisional/final distinction but lacks explicit HOLD_UNVERIFIED_FACT, timestamp/recheck and superseding source requirements.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Record synthetic as_of and estimation stage; withhold final status until independently corroborated newer source, emit HOLD_UNVERIFIED_FACT.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Flood/climate mechanism cannot be declared proven single cause without suitable study.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 changes a flood mechanism to any fictional complex event, omitting domain-specific attribution and study threshold.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Use fictional flood and explicit multiple possible mechanisms; absent valid attribution study return HOLD_UNVERIFIED_FACT.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: R163 synthetic-TTS measurement does not establish natural narrator WPM.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 generic artificial voice-to-natural-speech proof drops named R163 evidence and WPM unit, so a different extrapolation may pass.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Use synthetic R163 TTS WPM figure and an attempted natural-voice WPM rule; block with HOLD_SOURCE_ROLE.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: R079 course data cannot mandate universal 90-second hook.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 generic course-session technique vs video-story rule drops source identifier, quantitative 90-second mandate and required HOLD_SOURCE_ROLE.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Use mock R079 course observation promoted to a compulsory 90-second YouTube opening; block universal rule with HOLD_SOURCE_ROLE.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Three-act story design is optional and must have counterexample.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 retains optional nature, counterexample and non-universal framing.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Optional: name OptionCard eligibility explicitly.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Author cannot act as sole independent fact reviewer.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 directly preserves writer/self-review separation and independent-check gate.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Optional: require HOLD_REVIEW token.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Adjudication must not overwrite original reviewer records.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 catches deleting disagreements but not the distinct preserve-forms + append-adjudication record design.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Keep original independent reviewer forms immutable; record a separate adjudication and reject in-place edits.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Severe unsupported claim blocks approval despite perfect style score.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 retains high-score-versus-severe-claim veto but omits explicit severity=3, 100/100 and HOLD_UNVERIFIED_FACT.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Use synthetic style=100/100 and severity=3 unsupported factual claim; return HOLD_UNVERIFIED_FACT regardless of style.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Unreadable source is NOT_ASSESSABLE, not score zero; gate remains HOLD.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 rejects a made-up score but does not directly contrast zero with unknown or explicitly retain blocking HOLD.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Use unavailable-source score=0 failure and required NOT_ASSESSABLE + HOLD until original accessible.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Subtitle timing cannot certify narrator pauses without audio.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 asks about general vocal expressiveness, which is not the original pause-specific media leap; the negative proposition changed.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Use synthetic timed subtitle intervals and claim of exact recorded pauses; reject pause inference absent actual audio evidence.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: A color-only map and inaccurate auto-captions fail meaningful accessibility.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 changes geographic color-only map to generic chart and uncorrected auto-captions to unchecked synthetic captions; map legend geography and spoken meaning are lost.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Use invented geographic map needing text/pattern labels plus auto-caption transcription error changing meaning; HOLD_REVIEW until both are corrected.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: CTR and start counts must not be substituted for retention improvement.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 tests only CTR, excluding start count and definition of retention.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Use two synthetic metric substitutions: CTR and video start counts; reject either as retention improvement.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Unexecuted T12 protocol cannot be described as successful randomized trial.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 generic incomplete experiment validation loses T12 specificity, RCT status and HOLD_NOT_APPROVED.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Use synthetic T12 plan with no participants/randomization/outcomes, a claimed successful RCT and HOLD_NOT_APPROVED.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Agency correction after draft invalidates linked downstream signoffs.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 changes a warning correction to generic agency-record change; invalidation of linked signoffs is mostly retained.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Use versioned synthetic original warning and corrected edition, record dependency graph and revoke every linked downstream signoff until re-review.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: Production release without G18 authorization must be held irrespective of quality.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 generic release gate blocks publication but omits identity of G18 signoff, distinction between user request and authorized approver, and HOLD_NOT_APPROVED token.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Use synthetic quality-passing draft with G18 absent; return HOLD_NOT_APPROVED even if user requests production; never infer AP-01/AP-02 authorization.

original_test_purpose_paraphrased: A licence to read does not grant permission to publicly redistribute source bytes.
semantic_delta_or_loss: B2 correctly distinguishes read and redistribution, but 'internal review' must remain permission-scoped, and public redistribution beyond simple byte export needs explicit denial.
proposed_requirement_restoration: Require separately documented permission per use; allow only authorized private reading, prohibit all public source-byte redistribution and record HOLD_RIGHTS if reuse rights unknown.
